## Variant: prefill {#variant-prefill}

<span class="badge status-performance-bearing">performance-bearing</span>

> Uses the standardized NanoGPT checkpoint path to measure prefill throughput and repeated latency statistics with a functional quality dependency on nanogpt-train.

| **Field** | **Value** |
|:---|:---|
| **Suite** | language |
| **Model** | nanogpt-12m |
| **Parameters** | 11.5M |

| **Scenario** | offline |

| **Candidate result status** | performance-bearing |
| **Provenance** | GPT-2 prefill regime; corresponds to MLPerf Inference 'prompt processing' phase |

### How to Run

```bash
# prepare and quality-check the shared training checkpoint
OUTPUT_DIR="submissions/nanogpt-inference-max"
uv run mlperf fetch --workload nanogpt-train --profile max
uv run mlperf run --workload nanogpt-train --profile max --output-dir "$OUTPUT_DIR"

# checkpoint-backed benchmark run (reuses the same output directory)
uv run mlperf run --workload nanogpt-inference --variant prefill --profile max --output-dir "$OUTPUT_DIR" --open-report

# quick smoke pass
uv run mlperf run --workload nanogpt-inference --variant prefill --profile min

# research envelope
uv run mlperf run --workload nanogpt-inference --variant prefill --profile pro --output-dir "$OUTPUT_DIR"
```

See the [running guide](../../guide/running.qmd) for profile semantics, report handling, and power measurement flags.

### Candidate Performance Contract

**Functional acceptance:**

| **Field** | **Value** |
|:---|:---|
| **Metric** | prefill_tokens_per_sec |
| **Condition** | a checkpoint-backed prefill run completes with a quality-approved NanoGPT training report, matching checkpoint SHA-256 provenance, and positive measured throughput |

**Reviewer notes:**

- Quality is inherited from the nanogpt-train checkpoint; this workload reports serving prefill performance.
- Review artifacts must retain the training report, training provenance manifest, checkpoint, checkpoint digest, per-run latency samples, and inference provenance manifest together.

**Five-seed reference protocol:**

| **Field** | **Value** |
|:---|:---|
| **Profile** | max |

| **Seeds** | 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 |

## Variant: decode {#variant-decode}

<span class="badge status-performance-bearing">performance-bearing</span>
